verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs describe agents that use system integrations and customer context rather than only help articles. Insights shows the 'systems accessed' behind each answer, and the voice agent 'understands customer context, leverages memory' to deliver 'real-time resolutions'. A community hands-on report confirms it works with customers' internal APIs. The story's specific data types (plan, order status, account history) are not explicitly documented, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live lookups of plan, order status and account history in answers, independent evidence of answer accuracy grounded in live customer data, integration/connector specifics.
